Final for Publication

Amended to be a Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment
Narrative and Plans

4415-53 N. Pulaski Rd
‘From B1-1 to Cl-1
The subject property is improved with a one story retail strip center. The applicant
needs a zoning change to get a business license and reestablish a coin-operated
laundromat in an existing space in the strip center.
A. Applicant plans to reestablish a laundromat in the existing retail strip center.
B. The project has about 29,890 SF of commercial space for an FAR of about 0.56.
C. The lot area is about 53,466 SF but there are no residential units.
D. There are about 65 parking spaces.
E. The existing setbacks are shown on both the survey and site plan. See attached. No
changes.

F. The building height is about 15 feet. No changes.
